Rule.name: Aggregate Single Account
Rule.Description:
Targeted aggregation of ONE account, for any application. The account goes through the normal aggregation pipeline (customization rule, correlation, identity creation, attribute promotion), exactly as in a full aggregation.
How the account is read: - Applications that can fetch one account (LDAP ApacheDS): connector.getObject - Applications that cannot (HR Authoritative CSV, a delimited file): the file is read and only the matching row is kept
Edit APP_NAME and ACCOUNT_ID below, then run from the IIQ console: rule "Aggregate Single Account" Or call it with arguments appName and accountId, e.g. from another rule or a workflow: context.runRule(rule, {"appName": "...", "accountId": "..."})
ACCOUNT_ID is the account's native identity: HR Authoritative CSV : the employeeNumber, e.g. 1000 LDAP ApacheDS : the DN, e.g. uid=ashok.kumar,ou=people,dc=example,dc=com
